NKJV.1: Bel bows down, Nebo stoops; Their idols were on the beasts and on the cattle. Your carriages were heavily loaded, A burden to the weary beast.
NKJV.2: They stoop, they bow down together; They could not deliver the burden,  But have themselves gone into captivity.
NKJV.3: “Listen to Me, O house of Jacob, And all the remnant of the house of Israel, Who have been upheld by Me from birth, Who have been carried from the womb:
NKJV.4: Even to your old age, I am He, And even to gray hairs I will carry you! I have made, and I will bear; Even I will carry, and will deliver you.
NKJV.5: “To whom will you liken Me, and make Me equal And compare Me, that we should be alike?
NKJV.6: They lavish gold out of the bag, And weigh silver on the scales; They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god; They prostrate themselves, yes, they worship.
NKJV.7: They bear it on the shoulder, they carry it And set it in its place, and it stands; From its place it shall not move. Though one cries out to it, yet it cannot answer Nor save him out of his trouble.
NKJV.8: “Remember this, and show yourselves men;  Recall to mind, O you transgressors.
NKJV.9: Remember the former things of old, For I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like Me,
NKJV.10: Declaring the end from the beginning, And from ancient times things that are not yet done, Saying, ‘My counsel shall stand, And I will do all My pleasure,’
NKJV.11: Calling a bird of prey from the east, The man who executes My counsel, from a far country. Indeed I have spoken it; I will also bring it to pass. I have purposed it; I will also do it.
NKJV.12: “Listen to Me, you stubborn-hearted, Who are far from righteousness:
NKJV.13: I bring My righteousness near, it shall not be far off; My salvation shall not linger. And I will place salvation in Zion, For Israel My glory.

NASB.3: 'Listen to Me, O house of Jacob, And all the remnant of the house of Israel, You who have been borne by Me from birth And have been carried from the womb;
NASB.4: Even to [your] old age I will be the same, And even to [your] graying years I will bear [you]! I have done [it], and I will carry [you]; And I will bear [you] and I will deliver [you].
NASB.5: 'To whom would you liken Me And make Me equal and compare Me, That we would be alike?

NASB.7: 'They lift it upon the shoulder [and] carry it; They set it in its place and it stands [there]. It does not move from its place. Though one may cry to it, it cannot answer; It cannot deliver him from his distress.
NASB.8: 'Remember this, and be assured; Recall it to mind, you transgressors.
NASB.9: 'Remember the former things long past, For I am God, and there is no other; [I am] God, and there is no one like Me,
NASB.10: Declaring the end from the beginning, And from ancient times things which have not been done, Saying, 'My purpose will be established, And I will accomplish all My good pleasure';

NASB.12: 'Listen to Me, you stubborn-minded, Who are far from righteousness.
NASB.13: 'I bring near My righteousness, it is not far off; And My salvation will not delay. And I will grant salvation in Zion, [And] My glory for Israel.

ESV.1: Bel bows down; Nebo stoops; their idols are on beasts and livestock; these things you carry are borne as burdens on weary beasts.
ESV.2: They stoop; they bow down together; they cannot save the burden, but themselves go into captivity.
ESV.3: “Listen to me, O house of Jacob, all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been borne by me from before your birth, carried from the womb;
ESV.4: even to your old age I am he, and to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear; I will carry and will save.
ESV.5: “To whom will you liken me and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be alike?
ESV.6: Those who lavish gold from the purse, and weigh out silver in the scales, hire a goldsmith, and he makes it into a god; then they fall down and worship!
ESV.7: They lift it to their shoulders, they carry it, they set it in its place, and it stands there; it cannot move from its place. If one cries to it, it does not answer or save him from his trouble.
ESV.8: “Remember this and stand firm, recall it to mind, you transgressors,
ESV.9: remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like me,
ESV.10: declaring the end from the beginning and from ancient times things not yet done, saying, ‘My counsel shall stand, and I will accomplish all my purpose,’
ESV.11: calling a bird of prey from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. I have spoken, and I will bring it to pass; I have purposed, and I will do it.
ESV.12: “Listen to me, you stubborn of heart, you who are far from righteousness:
ESV.13: I bring near my righteousness; it is not far off, and my salvation will not delay; I will put salvation in Zion, for Israel my glory.”

as a burden for the weary animal.

but they themselves go into captivity. ⓝ

CSB17.8:
“Remember this and be brave; [1]

WEB.1: Bel bows down. Nebo stoops. Their idols are carried by animals, and on the livestock. The things that you carried around are heavy loads, a burden for the weary.
WEB.2: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.
WEB.3: “Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth, that have been carried from the womb.
WEB.4: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
WEB.5: “To whom will you liken me, and consider my equal, and compare me, that we may be equal?
WEB.6: Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They fall down — yes, they worship.
WEB.7: They bear it on their shoulder. They carry it, and set it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move from its place. Yes, one may cry to it, yet it can not answer. It cannot save him out of his trouble.
WEB.8: “Remember this, and show yourselves men. Bring it to mind again, you transgressors.
WEB.9: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.
WEB.10: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will stand, and I will do all that I please.
WEB.11: I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring it to pass. I have planned. I will also do it.
WEB.12: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!
WEB.13: I bring my righteousness near. It is not far off, and my salvation will not wait. I will grant salvation to Zion, my glory to Israel.

NLT.1:
Bel and Nebo, the gods of Babylon,
bow as they are lowered to the ground.
They are being hauled away on ox carts.
The poor beasts stagger under the weight.
NLT.2:
Both the idols and their owners are bowed down.
The gods cannot protect the people,
and the people cannot protect the gods.
They go off into captivity together.
NLT.3:
“Listen to me, descendants of Jacob,
all you who remain in Israel.
I have cared for you since you were born.
Yes, I carried you before you were born.
NLT.4:
I will be your God throughout your lifetime —
until your hair is white with age.
I made you, and I will care for you.
I will carry you along and save you.
NLT.5:
“To whom will you compare me?
Who is my equal?
NLT.6:
Some people pour out their silver and gold
and hire a craftsman to make a god from it.
Then they bow down and worship it!
NLT.7:
They carry it around on their shoulders,
and when they set it down, it stays there.
It can’t even move!
And when someone prays to it, there is no answer.
It can’t rescue anyone from trouble.
NLT.8:
“Do not forget this! Keep it in mind!
Remember this, you guilty ones.
NLT.9:
Remember the things I have done in the past.
For I alone am God!
I am God, and there is none like me.
NLT.10:
Only I can tell you the future
before it even happens.
Everything I plan will come to pass,
for I do whatever I wish.
NLT.11:
I will call a swift bird of prey from the east —
a leader from a distant land to come and do my bidding.
I have said what I would do,
and I will do it.
NLT.12:
“Listen to me, you stubborn people
who are so far from doing right.
NLT.13:
For I am ready to set things right,
not in the distant future, but right now!
I am ready to save Jerusalem
and show my glory to Israel.

AMP.1:
Bel has bowed down, Nebo stoops over;
Their idols are on the beasts [of burden] and on the cattle.
Your burdens [of idols] are loaded [on them],
Burdens on the weary animals.
AMP.2:
They stooped over, they have bowed down together;
They could not rescue the burden [of their own idols],
But have themselves gone into captivity.
AMP.3:
"Listen to Me," [says the LORD], "O house of Jacob,
And all the remnant of the house of Israel,
You who have been carried by Me from your birth
And have been carried [in My arms] from the womb,
AMP.4:
Even to your old age I am He,
And even to your advanced old age I will carry you!
I have made you, and I will carry you;
Be assured I will carry you and I will save you.
AMP.5:
"To whom would you liken Me
And make Me equal and compare Me,
That we may be alike?
AMP.6:
"Those who lavish gold from the bag
And weigh out silver on the scales
Hire a goldsmith, and he makes it into a god;
They bow down, indeed they worship it.
AMP.7:
"They lift it on their shoulders [in religious processions or into battle] and carry it;
They set it in its place and there it remains standing.
It cannot move from its place.
Even if one cries to it [for help], the idol cannot answer;
It cannot save him from his distress.
AMP.8:
"Remember this, and take courage;
Take it to heart, you rebellious and disloyal people.
AMP.9:
"Remember [carefully] the former things [which I did] from ages past;
For I am God, and there is no one else;
I am God, and there is no one like Me,
AMP.10:
Declaring the end and the result from the beginning,
And from ancient times the things which have not [yet] been done,
Saying, 'My purpose will be established,
And I will do all that pleases Me and fulfills My purpose,'
AMP.11:
Calling a bird of prey from the east,
From a far country, the man (Cyrus) of My purpose.
Truly I have spoken; truly I will bring it to pass.
I have planned it, be assured I will do it.
AMP.12:
"Listen to Me, you stiff-necked people,
You who are far from righteousness (right standing with God).
AMP.13:
"I bring near My righteousness [in the salvation of Israel], it is not far away;
And My salvation will not delay.
And I will grant salvation in Zion,
And My glory for Israel.

Gods of Babylon

their idols are borne by beasts of burden.

a burden for the weary.
NIV.2:
They stoop and bow down together;
unable to rescue the burden,
they themselves go off into captivity.
NIV.3:
“Listen to me, O house of Jacob,
all you who remain of the house of Israel,
you whom I have upheld since you were conceived,
and have carried since your birth.
NIV.4:
Even to your old age and gray hairs
I am he, I am he who will sustain you.
I have made you and I will carry you;
I will sustain you and I will rescue you.
NIV.5:
“To whom will you compare me or count me equal?
To whom will you liken me that we may be compared?

Some pour out gold from their bags
and weigh out silver on the scales;
they hire a goldsmith to make it into a god,

it cannot save him from his troubles.

take it to heart, you rebels.

MSG.1:
The god Bel falls down, god Nebo slumps.
The no-god hunks of wood are loaded on mules
And have to be hauled off,
wearing out the poor mules—
MSG.2:
Dead weight, burdens who can't bear burdens,
hauled off to captivity.
MSG.3:
"Listen to me, family of Jacob,
everyone that's left of the family of Israel.
I've been carrying you on my back
from the day you were born,
MSG.4:
And I'll keep on carrying you when you're old.
I'll be there, bearing you when you're old and gray.
I've done it and will keep on doing it,
carrying you on my back, saving you.
MSG.5:
"So to whom will you compare me, the Incomparable?
Can you picture me without reducing me?
MSG.6:
People with a lot of money
hire craftsmen to make them gods.
The artisan delivers the god,
and they kneel and worship it!
MSG.7:
They carry it around in holy parades,
then take it home and put it on a shelf.
And there it sits, day in and day out,
a dependable god, always right where you put it.
Say anything you want to it, it never talks back.
Of course, it never does anything either!
MSG.8:
"Think about this. Wrap your minds around it.
This is serious business, rebels. Take it to heart.
MSG.9:
Remember your history,
your long and rich history.
I am God, the only God you've had or ever will have—
incomparable, irreplaceable—
MSG.10:
From the very beginning
telling you what the ending will be,
All along letting you in
on what is going to happen,
Assuring you, 'I'm in this for the long haul,
I'll do exactly what I set out to do,'
MSG.11:
Calling that eagle, Cyrus, out of the east,
from a far country the man I chose to help me.
I've said it, and I'll most certainly do it.
I've planned it, so it's as good as done.
MSG.12:
"Now listen to me:
You're a hardheaded bunch and hard to help.
MSG.13:
I'm ready to help you right now.
Deliverance is not a long-range plan.
Salvation isn't on hold.
I'm putting salvation to work in Zion now,
and glory in Israel.

NET.1: Bel kneels down, Nebo bends low. Their images weigh down animals and beasts. Your heavy images are burdensome to tired animals.
NET.2: Together they bend low and kneel down; they are unable to rescue the images; they themselves head off into captivity.
NET.3: “Listen to me, O family of Jacob, all you who are left from the family of Israel, you who have been carried from birth, you who have been supported from the time you left the womb.
NET.4: Even when you are old, I will take care of you, even when you have gray hair, I will carry you. I made you and I will support you; I will carry you and rescue you.
NET.5: To whom can you compare and liken me? Tell me whom you think I resemble, so we can be compared!
NET.6: Those who empty out gold from a purse and weigh out silver on the scale hire a metalsmith, who makes it into a god. They then bow down and worship it.
NET.7: They put it on their shoulder and carry it; they put it in its place and it just stands there; it does not move from its place. Even when someone cries out to it, it does not reply; it does not deliver him from his distress.
NET.8: Remember this, so you can be brave! Think about it, you rebels!
NET.9: Remember what I accomplished in antiquity! Truly I am God, I have no peer; I am God, and there is none like me,
NET.10: who announces the end from the beginning and reveals beforehand what has not yet occurred, who says, ‘My plan will be realized, I will accomplish what I desire,’
NET.11: who summons an eagle from the east, from a distant land, one who carries out my plan. Yes, I have decreed, yes, I will bring it to pass; I have formulated a plan, yes, I will carry it out.
NET.12: Listen to me, you stubborn people, you who distance yourself from doing what is right.
NET.13: I am bringing my deliverance near, it is not far away; I am bringing my salvation near, it does not wait. I will save Zion; I will adorn Israel with my splendor.”
